model.description: One row per year, 1949 onward, of French annual national accounts in base 2020: GDP in value, volume and per inhabitant, the published contributions of demand components to GDP volume growth, the income-side split of GDP, domestic employment, and the AMECO-adjusted wage share.
model.name: french_national_accounts_annual

questions.derivation: Select the published GDP levels, per-inhabitant levels, price index and volume growth by year.
questions.question: How large is French GDP, in total and per inhabitant, and how fast has it grown in volume each year?

questions.derivation: Select the published contributions, which add up to GDP volume growth: final consumption, fixed capital formation, inventories, valuables and net trade, with their sector and trade splits.
questions.question: Which expenditure components carried or held back GDP volume growth in each year?

questions.derivation: Split GDP into compensation, operating surplus, mixed income and the two net-tax residuals; impute to each non-employee the average compensation per employee and move that amount from mixed income and surplus to labour.
questions.question: How is GDP shared between labour, capital and net taxes, once non-employees are credited with a wage?

temporal.meaning: Each period is the first day of the calendar year whose flows, averages or year-on-year changes the row carries.

validations.description: There is exactly one row per year.
validations.name: unique-period

validations.description: No year is missing between the first and the last.
validations.name: years_are_consecutive

validations.description: Each published column is fed by exactly one provider series.
validations.name: every_selector_matches_one_series

validations.description: Final consumption, fixed capital formation, inventories, valuables and net trade add up to GDP volume growth within the provider's rounding.
validations.name: expenditure_contributions_sum_to_gdp_growth

validations.description: Sector contributions add up to final consumption and to fixed capital formation, and exports and imports to net trade, within rounding.
validations.name: sector_contributions_sum_to_their_totals

validations.description: Employees and non-employees add up to total employment within rounding.
validations.name: employees_and_non_employees_make_up_employment

validations.description: The income components, unadjusted and adjusted, close on GDP.
validations.name: income_components_make_up_gdp

validations.description: Shares lie within 0-100, levels are non-negative, and growth and contributions lie within plus or minus 25.
validations.name: within_range
